input: Hi all, what a busy week! I loved seeing everyone's photos from the trip. Important: the office will be closed next Monday for a public holiday, so please plan your work around it. Talk soon, Lena

Dear parents, the children had so much fun at sports day! Thank you for the cakes. Please note that school will start at 9:30 instead of 8:30 on Wednesday because of staff training. Warm wishes, Mr. Lee
Hi! Hope you're all doing well. A quick reminder that our client, Greenleaf, has asked us to send the final design by Thursday at noon instead of Friday. Thanks, and enjoy your lunch! Priya
Hello team, the new chairs arrived and they are so comfortable! Also, the Wi-Fi password has changed to BlueSky42. Please update your laptops today. Cheers, Tom
Hi everyone, I hope you enjoyed the long weekend. Our project budget has been cut from $10,000 to $8,000, so we need to drop one of the planned features. Let's talk at the next meeting. Best, Ana
Dear students, thank you for coming to the career fair. During exam week the library will close at 6pm instead of 9pm, so please plan your study time. Good luck! The Library Team
Hi Sara, thanks for the lovely chat yesterday. I just wanted to say that your job interview is confirmed for Tuesday at 10am in Room 204. Please bring a copy of your CV. See you then! Daniel
Hey all, hope you had a relaxing weekend! Our team is moving to the third floor on Monday, so please pack your desks by Friday afternoon. Thanks, Kim
Hello! What a sunny week it has been. Next Friday's school trip to the science museum is now full, so no more students can sign up. Thank you all! Mrs. Gomez

Hi team, I hope you're all well and enjoying the new snacks in the kitchen. Our software will be down for an update on Saturday from 8am to noon. Please save your work before you leave on Friday. Thanks, IT Support
